findings.title: order() mixin off-by-one for legacy box spec
findings.body: In mixins.scss the order() mixin sets -webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group to the same value as order. The legacy box spec is 1-indexed (ordinal-group = order + 1), so @include order(2) / order(3) used in topic.scss and header.scss renders as 2/3 instead of 3/4 in old WebKit/Firefox. Consequence is wrong visual ordering of header .panel vs .extra-info-wrapper on those browsers.

findings.title: float:right ignored on flex item breaks small-action button
findings.body: .small-action is made a flex container in topic-post.scss but its child button still relies on float: right and .topic-avatar on float: left. Per CSS Flexbox, float and clear have no effect on flex items, so the button will no longer stick to the right edge and will instead lay out inline after the description. The layout needs justify-content or margin-left:auto instead of float.

findings.title: Invalid -ms-align-items property in align-items mixin
findings.body: The align-items() mixin in mixins.scss emits -ms-align-items, which was never a valid IE10 property; IE10 only understands -ms-flex-align. The invalid declaration is dropped, and -ms-flex-align does not support all modern values such as baseline used for .badge-wrapper.bullet. Consequence is dead code and inconsistent vertical alignment in IE10.
